description_en: Associates an asset group with an Anti-DDoS Origin instance
description_zh: 创建资产组和防护包实例绑定关系
kebab_example: aliyun ddosbgp attach-asset-group-to-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --instance-id 'ddosbgp-cn-n6w1r7nz****' --asset-group-list Type=waf Region=cn-hangzhou Name=waf-test-001 --api-version 2018-07-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AttachAssetGroupToInstance

parameters.help_en:
The region ID of the Anti-DDoS Origin instance.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html operation to query all region IDs supported by Anti-DDoS Origin
parameters.help_zh:
DDoS原生防护实例所在地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118703.html查询DDoS原生防护支持的所有地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the purchased Anti-DDoS Origin instance with which you want to associate the asset group. The ID is prefixed with ddosbgp-cn-.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118698.html operation to query the IDs of existing instances. If no available instance is found, purchase an instance on the Anti-DDoS Origin 2.0 buy page first
parameters.help_zh:
要绑定资产组的已购买 DDoS 原生防护实例 ID，ID 前缀为 ddosbgp-cn-。

您可以调用 https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/118698.html 查询已有实例的 ID。如果未查询到可用实例，请先通过 DDoS 原生防护 2.0 购买页面购买实例
parameters.name: instance_id

fields.help_en: The UID of the member accounts to which the asset group belongs
fields.name: member_uid

fields.help_en: The ID of the asset instance to add. For WAF, this parameter specifies the WAF instance ID
fields.help_zh: 要添加的资产实例ID。对于WAF，指WAFf的实例ID
fields.name: name

fields.help_en: The region ID of the asset instance
fields.name: region

fields.help_en: The type of the asset group
fields.name: type

parameters.help_en: The information about the asset groups to associate
parameters.name: asset_group_list

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. The ID is a unique identifier generated by Alibaba Cloud for the request and can be used to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
